Table 17 is a deliciously heartfelt study of an ex-couple that’s as funny as it is profound.
It’s a simple agenda, utterly devoid of pretense, and the playwright and his cohorts accomplish their mission with irresistible flair.
Table 17 is proof positive that even the frothiest of plays can be spun into theatrical pleasure (if not gold) with the right combination of acting, directing, and design.
